models_evaluated: 18 multimodal large language models (not named in the text)

links.outcome: MLLM versus expert clinician performance on differential diagnosis generation and final diagnosis selection
links.effect: Top models often match or outperform human experts on DDx generation, but all MLLMs show a much larger DDx-FDx performance gap than expert clinicians.
links.quote: While top models often match or even outperform human experts on DDx generation, all MLLMs exhibit a much larger DDx--FDx performance gap compared to expert clinicians, indicating a failure mode in synthesis of heterogeneous CE types.

unlisted_practices: Evidence Sensitivity metric to quantify cross-modal clinical evidence utilization gap
Evidence-type ablations to diagnose overreliance on textual evidence

screen.reason: The study introduces a medical benchmark (MEDSYN) to evaluate the ability of multimodal LLMs to synthesize diverse clinical evidence for differential and final diagnosis.
